name: Breakfast bars + leftover fruit, coffee/tea, hot chocolate (no cooking)
equipment: burner + large kettle or pot for hot water
notes: No cooking beyond hot water. Leftover fruit from earlier meals goes out here instead of buying more.
Choose nut-free bars without gelatin (check labels) while allergy status is unknown.
Storage: bag opened bars and leftover fruit to go home.
roles: Set-out (1 adult + scouts): bars, fruit, drinks station

steps.text: Set out breakfast bars ({breakfast_bars}) and all the leftover fruit from yesterday.

serving: About 1-2 bars each; fruit while it lasts (it's leftovers, not one per person).
food_safety: Keep hot water away from the kids' side of the table.
cleanup: Bag opened bars and remaining fruit to go home. Pack out all trash.

diet.kosher: Check the bars for a kosher symbol.
